name: esg-commitment-audit
description: Evidence-first ESG and climate commitment structure auditing with local and hosted modes.

interface.shortDescription: Audit ESG and climate commitments with traceable evidence
interface.longDescription: Extract written ESG and climate commitments, apply the ICS CRV observability-enforceability-reversibility framework, and surface missing boundaries, baselines, owners, review mechanisms, remedies, and page-level evidence. Local audits run on-device; hosted audits require an authorized API key.
defaultPrompt: Audit this ESG or climate report and show structural evidence gaps with page-level citations.
